title: Marketing Assistant
description: Our Marketing team is growing and we are looking for a Marketing Assistant. You will manage budgets and agencies, create and edit content for web, email and social media, work with sales and product on launches and plan and run multi-channel campaigns. No professional experience needed; internships and personal projects count. You should be confident with SEO, Brand Strategy, Market Research, Marketing Automation and Google Analytics. Experience with Social Media, Campaign Management and Public Relations is a plus. Location: Remote (EU).
